name: Frisco Family Services Market — Food Pantry Volunteer
description: Help accept and sort food donations, stock shelves, check inventory, and assist clients at the Frisco Market. Teens 16–17 may volunteer independently after orientation; ages 11–15 must volunteer with a parent or guardian.

name: Frisco Family Services — Donation Sorting
description: Sort and process donated clothing, furniture, and household goods for Frisco Resale.

name: Frisco Family Services — Agency Office
description: Provide staff and client support through light office work.

name: Frisco Family Services — Seasonal Programs
description: Help with setup and execution of seasonal client programs and special events.

name: Minnie's Food Pantry — Pantry Volunteer
description: Sort, pack, and help hand out food at the Plano pantry. Each volunteer shift is 4 hours. Volunteers must be at least 16; volunteers under 18 must attend with an adult or guardian.

name: Minnie's Food Pantry — Food Packing
description: Help pack food bags and prepare pantry distributions. Volunteers must be at least 16; volunteers under 18 must attend with an adult or guardian.

name: Minnie's Food Pantry — Food Distribution
description: Help distribute food to families at the Plano pantry. Each volunteer shift is 4 hours. Volunteers must be at least 16; volunteers under 18 must attend with an adult or guardian.

name: Community Food Pantry of McKinney — Stock Shelves
description: Unload deliveries and keep pantry shelves stocked. No prior experience is required.

name: Community Food Pantry of McKinney — Sort Food
description: Check dates and move food from the back room onto pantry shelves.

name: Community Food Pantry of McKinney — Shopper Support
description: Welcome pantry visitors and walk the aisles with shoppers who would like assistance.

name: All Community Outreach — Food Pantry
description: Welcome and assist clients, stock shelves, and unload food deliveries. Volunteers ages 12–14 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

name: All Community Outreach — Cares Center
description: Sort and process donations, greet clients, and stock shelves. This role requires volunteers to be 18 or older.

name: All Community Outreach — Front Desk
description: Help with clerical tasks, answer phones, and greet guests. This role requires volunteers to be 18 or older.

name: All Community Outreach — Seasonal Food Programs
description: Help with seasonal programs such as Kids Summer Food and Holiday Food. Volunteers ages 12–14 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

name: Metrocrest Services — Client Choice Pantry
description: Help clients check in, restock and load pantry items, and assist with checkout. Minimum age is 13; ages 13–15 must be accompanied by a parent or adult guardian.

name: Metrocrest Services — Donation Sorting
description: Sort donated items into categories for distribution through the food pantry. Volunteers should be able to lift up to 25 pounds.

name: Metrocrest Services — Teaching Garden
description: Help with composting, watering, harvesting produce, weeding, and general garden maintenance.

name: Little Elm Area Food Bank — Food Box Packing
description: Help fill food boxes and prepare food distributions. The food bank offers volunteer opportunities for individuals and groups.

name: Little Elm Area Food Bank — Shelf Restocking
description: Help restock shelves and organize supplies at the food bank.

name: Denton Community Food Center — Shopper
description: Help pantry shoppers during Monday morning distribution. The center is volunteer-managed and welcomes regular volunteers.

name: Denton Community Food Center — Distribution
description: Help with food distribution on Monday or Wednesday mornings.

name: Denton Community Food Center — Freight Collection
description: Help collect freight for the food center on Monday, Wednesday, or Friday mornings.
